		context_type = decision_category
		window_name = "LR_fra_opposition_window"
		triggers = {
			LR_op_paris_crush_click_enabled = {
				has_political_power > 24
				check_variable = { LR_op_paris > 0 }
			}
			LR_op_paris_appease_click_enabled = {
				has_political_power > 49
